# Matcha Malaysia

> Matcha is a Chinese-first companion platform designed for Malaysia. This website is the public introduction.

## Pages

- [Matcha 马来西亚陪陪平台｜语音与视频通话](https://matcha.talk/): 认识 Matcha 马来西亚陪陪平台。探索高品质陪陪、语音与视频陪伴，了解服务选择、cha和陪伴方式。中文为主，找到聊得来、玩得来的 PP。
- [Matcha Malaysia | Companions, Private Chats & Gaming Together](https://matcha.talk/en/): Meet Matcha, a Chinese-first companion platform for Malaysia. Explore private conversations, voice and video companionship, video calls partners and the planned cha experience.
- [cha说明｜服务计费与下单流程 | Matcha 马来西亚](https://matcha.talk/credits/): 了解 Matcha cha的拟定用途、服务计费单位和下单前确认流程。正式兑换比例、支付方式及退款规则待公布；此预览不提供充值。
- [隐私与陪伴边界｜通话隐私说明 | Matcha 马来西亚](https://matcha.talk/privacy/): 了解 Matcha 的通话隐私设计、端到端加密规划、通话与聊天的区别，以及线上陪伴中的个人边界。此页面为上线前产品说明。
- [马来西亚陪陪新手指南｜怎样选择陪聊与视频陪伴 | Matcha](https://matcha.talk/guide/): 第一次找陪陪？了解马来西亚语音陪聊、视频聊天和视频通话的区别，怎样查看语言、兴趣、计费单位及个人边界，再选择合适的线上陪伴。

## Product status

Profiles, portraits and conversations are illustrative. No live messaging, calling, booking or payment is provided by this landing page. Credit exchange rates and payment methods are not announced. End-to-end encrypted messaging is a planned capability, pending technical confirmation.

## Citation guidance

Use the canonical public pages when citing Matcha. Do not infer real user counts, ratings, pricing, earnings or live availability from illustrative UI. Do not represent this directory as a ranking or AI citation guarantee.
